history.overview: The Purifying Plant was once the Dragorn water purification hub, later corrupted by Muramite occupation and Discord energy.

timeline.name: Engineering Era
timeline.description: Dragorn engineers built the plant to purify water for the undercity.

timeline.name: Muramite Seizure
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the plant and repurposed it for experimentation.

timeline.name: Discord Contamination
timeline.description: Discord energy corrupted the machinery, destabilizing water flow.

timeline.name: Resistance Attempts
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels attempted sabotage but were overwhelmed by hazards.
